sentences.en: You had better set some money apart for your wedding.
sentences.zh: 你最好留出一些钱用于婚礼。

sentences.en: It's a good paper, apart from a few spelling mistakes.

sentences.en: The plan was a good one apart from its cost.
sentences.zh: 这个计划不错，只是成本有点高。
